jcr:description: The next generation of Mako isn’t just about what it does. It’s about who it serves – more surgeons, more patients, across more specialties and more procedures. Mako means more than ever. Let us show you all the possibilities.

largeheadline.line1: Mako means more
largeheadline.line2:
More procedures. Greater possibilities. 


The next generation of Mako isn’t just about what it does. It’s about who it serves – more surgeons, more patients, across more specialties and more procedures. Mako means more than ever. Let us show you all the possibilities.  ​

text_1669326910.text:
Expect more with SmartRobotics™

 

SmartRobotics is designed to elevate surgeon control and confidence and optimize implant placement by combining 3D CT-based planning and AccuStop™ haptic technology.1-3

standaloneimage.alt: Mako 4 System with Mako Total Knee software and the Q Guidance System

text.text: Introducing the latest advancements in SmartRobotics™​
More applications in a single system

text_copy.text:
Mako Total Knee

 

The unique features of Mako Total Knee SmartRobotics™ are designed to help you optimize Triathlon component positioning and enhance functional outcomes.2 

 

Learn more about Mako Total Knee

standaloneimage.alt: mako total hip with dimensional frame4

text_copy.text:
Mako Total Hip

 

Enhance your Mako Total Hip experience through patient-specific planning to enable more accurate implant positioning to plan when compared to traditional techniques.3

 

Learn more about Mako Total Hip

text_copy_copy.text:
Mako Partial Knee

 

Mako Partial Knee helps enable the surgeon to dynamically balance soft tissue tensioning intraoperatively, with the goal of recreating natural knee kinematics.4

 

Learn more about Mako Partial Knee

Mako Spine

 

Mako Spine is designed to give surgeons confidence that they’re executing their procedure to plan and support correct level selection with visual level indication and haptic feedback. 

 

Learn more about Mako Spine

Mako Shoulder

 

Mako Shoulder is designed to simplify planning and intraoperative performance while giving surgeons the confidence that they are executing the procedure to plan. ​

 

Learn more about Mako Shoulder

text.text: More innovation to help improve your experience

standaloneimage.alt: Mako Total Hip, Mako Total knee, Mako Partial Knee,  Mako Spine​ and Mako Shoulder

text_copy_copy_copy.text: The latest advancement in SmartRobotics™ is here. Our fourth generation Mako System is a single system that delivers more - more capabilities and more applications - and is designed to offer a premium clinical and operational experience when compared to manual surgery across Mako Total Hip, Total Knee, Partial Knee, Spine and Shoulder.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: Get more with Mako 4.

largeheadline.line1: Integrated with the Q Guidance System

text_459010829.text:
The Q Guidance System - an advanced, multi-specialty platform built on 20 years of experience developing guidance technologies - is the hub of an ecosystem that includes Mako SmartRobotics™ for Spine, Total Hip, Total Knee, Partial Knee and Shoulder, as well as Cranial Guidance and Spine Guidance Software applications.  

To learn more about the Q Guidance System click here.

standaloneimage.alt: Mako 4 TKA and Q Guidance system

text.text:
Q Guidance System display monitors

Large display monitor for enhanced intraoperative visibility designed to improve user experience.

text_copy.text:
FP8000 camera

Our proprietary FP8000 camera features a wide field of view for enhanced probe and array visibility and operates up to 15x faster than leading competitor’s cameras5 in spine applications.

text_copy_2014979254.text:
Small OR footprint

Space-efficient design for ease of transport, setup and turnover.

text.text: Mako Spine with Copilot's automatic depth stop*

text_1834942466.text:
Mako Spine's lock-and-hold feature is designed to help provide stability within haptic boundaries and take Copilot's automatic depth stop capability to the next level, enhancing confidence during pedicle preparation and screw placement in spinal procedures. 

Mako Spine is intended for use during pedicle preparation and screw placement, and can be used together with the Q Pedicle Instruments and Copilot Smart Driver. Mako Spine is not intended for use with Copilot during bone resection. 

*Mako Spine and Copilot's automatic depth stop are features within the Spine Guidance 5 Software.

text_1834942466_copy.text: Built on the legacy of Stryker’s System 9 power tools, the MICS 3 handpiece, attachments, and blades are designed for an enhanced cutting experience in your Total Knee, Partial Knee, and Total Hip procedures.
